notes: Four supplied English function words (t001, t002, t011, t014) are added: the Hebrew writes no conjunction for the first clause, no waw before שְׂרֵפָה, and no subordinator for either recast clause (rules 14, 55). The ASV italics corroborate without deciding (rule 7).
The supplied *the* of 'the whole land thereof' joins the noun's unit rather than the quantifier's, discontinuous around *whole* (rules 15, 25).
כָּל־עֵשֶׂב keeps its own *any* beside the *nor* of the waw-plus-negative fusion, so rule 35's quantifier fusion does not reach it (a word is written for each).
Variant unit WLC.DEU.29.23.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the fallback reading is among those the ASV permits, so rule 53 does not apply.
